records.source: Hey, Robin is teaching me some innovative techniques this year.#$e#I'll have to show you later...$1
records.translation: 嘿，羅賓今年正在教我一些創新的技巧。#$e#晚點我一定要展示給你看……$1

records.source: I hope we win the grange display contest! You worked really hard this year.
records.translation: 希望我們能贏得農產品展評比！你今年真的非常努力。

records.source: Come here, sit for a while! There's space on the bench for the both of us.$1
records.translation: 過來坐一會兒吧！長椅上有足夠的位置讓我們一起坐。$1

records.source: It's a little funny seeing Alex stuff his face. He seems to be doing well.#$e#I hope we win the grange display contest this year!$1
records.translation: 看艾力克斯狼吞虎嚥的樣子有點好笑。他看來過得不錯。#$e#希望我們今年能贏得農產品展評比！$1

records.source: Sandy traveled all the way from Calico Desert to be here today.#$b#It's not very often that I get to see her!
records.translation: 珊迪今天特地從卡利科沙漠遠道而來。#$b#我難得有機會見到她！

records.source: That lady in the graveyard predicted our future...$0#$b#Apparently, we're destined to live a happy life together.$1
records.translation: 墓園裡那位女士預言了我們的未來……$0#$b#看來我們命中注定要一起過著幸福的生活。$1

records.source: Hey, are you enjoying the festival? I'll be rooting for our grange display!$0#$e#Psst... If you're going to bet your tokens on the wheel... bet on green!$0
records.translation: 嘿，你玩得開心嗎？我會替我們的農產品展加油！$0#$e#噓……如果你要在輪盤上下注星星代幣……押綠色！$0

records.source: Did you eat yet? There's almost too much to go around!$0#$e#I already ate three sandwiches... Mmm... that sauce...
records.translation: 你吃過了嗎？這裡的食物多得幾乎吃不完！$0#$e#我已經吃了三個三明治……嗯……那個醬汁……

records.source: Hi, honey. Good luck today in the competition. I just know you're going to shine!$0
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的。祝你今天比賽順利。我就知道你一定會大放異彩！$0

records.source: Victory! I achieved a score of '216' with five fish caught... a new personal best!$1#$e#Now, I must choose a fitting prize to purchase for you with these star tokens...$0
records.translation: 勝利！我釣到五條魚，拿下「216」分……創下個人新紀錄！$1#$e#現在，我得挑一份合適的獎品，用這些星星代幣買給你……$0

records.source: I might ask you to watch the animals soon so I can grab some food.$0
records.translation: 我可能很快會請你幫忙看著動物，好讓我去拿點吃的。$0

records.source: This blade is so elegant. Maybe some day I'll have enough money to buy one!$0
records.translation: 這把刀刃真優雅。也許有一天我能存夠錢買一把！$0

records.source: If you want to master the wood, you have to think like a tree...$0
records.translation: 想要掌握木材，就得像樹一樣思考……$0

records.source: Sheep have remarkable memory capabilities... retaining familiarity with both fellow sheep and humans...$0#$e#They even form friendships, mirroring the close bonds we humans cultivate with one another!$1
records.translation: 綿羊擁有非凡的記憶能力……能一直記得熟悉的同伴與人類……$0#$e#牠們甚至會建立友誼，就像人類彼此培養的緊密關係！$1

records.source: There's so much to do! I don't know where to begin.$0
records.translation: 能做的事太多了！我不知道該從哪裡開始。$0

records.source: That lady told me my fortune. I don't know what to make of it...$0
records.translation: 那位女士替我占卜了。我不知道該怎麼看待結果……$0

records.source: Animals are kind of like little people... they also have feelings and emotions.$0
records.translation: 動物有點像小小的人……牠們也有感受和情緒。$0

records.source: I'm confident that I'll emerge victorious in this year's grange display competition!$1
records.translation: 我有信心贏得今年的農產品展評比！$1

records.source: Some of the produce in our grange display came from my little greenhouse. We've been carefully growing this stuff all year!$0
records.translation: 我們農產品展裡有些作物來自我的小溫室。我們一整年都在悉心栽培這些東西！$0

records.source: Every hundred rounds of the strength game I win, I eat another BBQ sandwich.$0
records.translation: 測力遊戲每贏一百回合，我就再吃一個烤肉三明治。$0

records.source: %George is on the verge of falling asleep.
records.translation: %George快要睡著了。

records.source: Hee hee... Maybe I should start a collection of clown figurines...
records.translation: 呵呵……也許我該開始收藏小丑雕像……

records.source: Greetings, @! The 'Stardew Valley Fair' is finally here and the crowd is growing by the minute.#$b#Just like last year, I've set up an empty grange display for you. Speak with me when you're ready to commence the judging.
records.translation: 你好，@！「星露谷展覽會」終於登場，人群每分鐘都在增加。#$b#和去年一樣，我替你準備了一個空的農產品展位。準備好開始評審時就來找我。

records.source: It's heartening to see others take an interest in my work. Makes me feel like I'm doing something good in the world.#$e#I finished some of these pieces just last week. Please inspect them closely, I stand behind my work!
records.translation: 看到別人對我的作品感興趣，真令人振奮。這讓我覺得自己正在為世界做點好事。#$e#其中有些作品上週才完工。請仔細看看，我願意為自己的手藝擔保！

records.source: *phew* After being on my feet all day, it's nice to finally take a moment to relax.$0
records.translation: *呼* 站了一整天，終於能稍微坐下來放鬆真好。$0

records.source: Life don't get much better than this, kid!$1
records.translation: 孩子，人生沒什麼比這更享受的了！$1

records.source: When Sandy and I were kids, we joked about running away from it all and joining the circus.$0#$e#I don't think we would've actually gone through with it, but it's fun to imagine.$1
records.translation: 我和珊迪小時候開玩笑說，要拋下一切離家加入馬戲團。$0#$e#我想我們其實不會真的付諸行動，但想像一下也很有趣。$1

records.source: I'm trying to maintain a diet this fall... but I can't resist these juicy burgers!$h
records.translation: 今年秋天我正努力控制飲食……但實在無法抗拒這些多汁的漢堡！$h

records.source: Oh no. Who's responsible for littering here?$2#$e#Every year we get some tourists that don't respect our town...$2
records.translation: 糟糕。是誰在這裡亂丟垃圾？$2#$e#每年都有一些不尊重我們小鎮的觀光客……$2

records.source: *chuckle* My son has a knack for accuracy. I wonder if he got it from me.$1
records.translation: *輕笑* 我兒子很有瞄準的天分。不知道是不是遺傳自我。$1

records.source: I'm in the market for a new weapon. I wonder if I could negotiate a trade with Clint...
records.translation: 我正想買一把新武器。不知道能否和克林特談成一筆交易……

records.source: Ugh... I gambled and lost it all to the spinning wheel...$2#$e#I should've went with green.$0
records.translation: 唉……我把星星代幣全押在輪盤上，結果輸光了……$2#$e#我早該押綠色。$0

records.source: I think Robin and I make a pretty good team, don't you think?
records.translation: 我覺得羅賓和我是很不錯的搭檔，你不這麼認為嗎？

records.source: The animals have been given their favorite foods, so they're happy.$h#$e#Feel free to pet them, they won't bite.
records.translation: 動物們吃過最喜歡的食物，所以都很開心。$h#$e#儘管摸摸牠們吧，牠們不會咬人。

records.source: My animals had a successful year! I'm hoping the high-quality produce will impress the judges.$1#$e#How's your grange display, @? It's your moment to showcase the fruits of your labor.$0
records.translation: 我的動物今年表現很好！希望這些高品質產品能讓評審留下深刻印象。$1#$e#你的農產品展怎麼樣了，@？現在正是展示辛勤成果的時刻。$0

records.source: Ah, don't mind the smell... I just emerged from the fishing booth with a sizable haul!$1#$e#Now, I must decide what to do with all these star tokens...$0
records.translation: 啊，別在意這股氣味……我剛帶著豐厚漁獲從釣魚攤位出來！$1#$e#現在，我得決定如何運用這些星星代幣……$0

records.source: Working four grills simultaneously is hard work! There's a large and hungry crowd to cater to today.$0#$e#I put a little dash of my zesty sauce in each patty. *wink*
records.translation: 同時照看四座烤架可不輕鬆！今天得招待一大群飢腸轆轆的人。$0#$e#每塊肉排裡我都加了一點酸香醬汁。*眨眼*

records.source: I was curious about this human gathering... $0#$e#Please don't tell anyone. I'm hoping to remain hidden here...$0
records.translation: 我對這場人類聚會很好奇……$0#$e#請別告訴任何人。我希望能繼續躲在這裡……$0

records.source: If you wish to peer through the mists of tomorrow, speak to my colleague Welwick.$0#$b#She has an uncommon gift...#$e#That young man by the tree seemed intrigued by his reading, but even with my powers, I cannot probe the innermost secrets of the heart...$0
records.translation: 若想看穿明日的迷霧，就去找我的同僚韋爾維克。$0#$b#她擁有罕見的天賦……#$e#樹旁那位年輕人似乎對占卜結果很感興趣，但即使憑我的力量，也無法探查心底最深處的祕密……$0

records.source: I'm astonished by the level of craftsmanship on display here. Some people are so talented!$0
records.translation: 這裡展現的工藝水準令我驚嘆。有些人真是才華洋溢！$0

records.source: The Stardew Valley community is truly one-of-a-kind...$0
records.translation: 星露谷這個社區真的獨一無二……$0

records.source: Mooo! Moooooo!$1#$e#I'm trying to talk to the baby cows.$0
records.translation: 哞！哞——！$1#$e#我正在試著和小牛說話。$0

records.source: Can I play the slingshot game again, Dad!? Please?$0
records.translation: 爸爸，我可以再玩一次彈弓遊戲嗎！？拜託？$0

records.source: I managed to catch several iridium-quality beauties, just in time for this year's fair!$1#$e#After our grange displays are judged I'll have to try my hand at the fishing game tent.$0
records.translation: 我及時為今年的展覽會釣到幾條銥品質的漂亮大魚！$1#$e#等農產品展評審結束後，我得去釣魚遊戲帳篷一試身手。$0

records.source: I'm making friends with these birds!$1
records.translation: 我正在和這些鳥兒交朋友！$1
